fields.name: form
fields.notes: Required on kind doc, refused on every other kind.

fields.name: status
fields.notes: draft, stable, deprecated, template for documents; proposed, accepted, superseded for ADRs.

fields.name: owner
fields.notes: A team or a person, grammar [A-Za-z0-9._@-]+; TBD names no owner and inherits.

fields.name: public_api
fields.notes: The boundary file (a package's __init__.py), or none.

fields.name: id
fields.notes: Stable and unique across the corpus; kept when the file moves.

fields.name: updated
fields.notes: Touched: never earlier than the author date of the file's last commit.

fields.name: visibility
fields.notes: Least restrictive first; a node takes the most restrictive on its chain of READMEs.

fields.name: canonical
fields.notes: true when this is the authoritative copy, else the path or id of the one that is.

fields.name: superseded_by
fields.notes: Required when status is deprecated or superseded.

families.what: A milestone in the project's register. It is complete when every node planned to it has passed and no untriaged finding holds it. Its version is the record schema's.

Jarvis's export of its record schema: record kinds, field homes, stages, registries, value formats and every field of the node and requirement records. Every Jarvis reader takes labels, order and choices from it. The vault holds a copy made by record_schema_export().

skeleton: homes:          [store, ledger, derived, contract, frontmatter, body]

fields.name: homes
fields.notes: of store, ledger, derived, contract, frontmatter, body

fields.name: records
fields.notes: node and requirement, each with sections and fields

families.what: A box on a board that drives work. Config only, never drawing: id (stable), owner, drives (the doc it pins to), parent (what it nests in), side (own or external), intent (planned or wanted, until code exists), milestone, serves. Its build state is computed from code and checks, never typed. When Jarvis drives the project, the box is the node's id and every other field is read from the node.

fields.name: id
fields.notes: stable, never reused, never a path. The Jarvis node id when Jarvis drives the project

fields.name: owner
fields.notes: who decides changes to the box

fields.name: drives
fields.notes: the doc section it pins to

fields.name: intent
fields.notes: declared only until code exists. Built status is computed, never typed

families.what: An arrow, declared once on its source: to, says (the words on the line), kind (flow, statement), both ways or not. Whether it is built is computed. Kinds come from the legend.

fields.name: says
fields.notes: the words on the line: what moves

fields.name: kind
fields.notes: the legend's arrow kinds. Statement arrows are drawn blue
